title: メールアカウントでの同期も

author: 自民立憲解党

title: great app if you’re willing to pay
body: Great app, but as it is advertised in many places as free, I found it has a little too little free content. I.e. it’s great if you pay, but if you don’t, bear in mind you’ll only get three habits to log.
author: habitier

title: Cannot use app
body:

iOS 13 latest, iPhone 11, on wifi.
author: SAY KOU SHOW

title: It’s perfect
body: I was looking for something simple to help me towards my goals. I’m a senior citizen and didn’t want anything too complex although I think this app is for anyone of any age. Great app, easy to use, lots of categories to choose from. Thanks!
author: grsmmaC

title: いいアプリだけど
body:
- No trackers are displayed in the widget even there are two trackers which are due today at noon.

- It is tough to flick to "log Yes" or "log No" because I have to move my thumb longer than other iOS apps.
author: メテオ大魔神

title: Watch app has display issue
body:
iPhone app is okay
However watch app displays twice my habits...
It looks like a bug
author: Johnnnnnny509

title: Great App for managing habits & projects
body: I love how many habits you get in the free version, as well as the ability to create step by step checklists for your projects! The design and user interface is also wonderful - I love being able to check off tasks from the today menu or just by swiping left/right! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to get their life together!

title: Amazing tracking app!
body:
This app is an amazing app. 
No clutter with unnecessary stats, just the numbers you need to keep yourself motivates. 

Beautiful graphics and GUI, combined with stupendous functionality. 

Thanks for a great app.
